articles.title: Bitcoin nearing late stages of bear market: Jamie Coutts, Real Vision
articles.snippet: Real Vision chief crypto analyst Jamie Coutts said it's far too early to call $1 million by 2030, but he's confident Bitcoin could climb up to $250,000 over the next couple of years.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation Turns AI Loose on ETH Network to Find Bugs Before Hackers Do
articles.snippet: Ethereum researchers are using AI agents to hunt for vulnerabilities, shifting security work from finding bugs to proving which ones are real.
